description: Nameplates whose lights data is already deliberately split across multiple generation/body-style model slugs sharing one display name (e.g. Nissan Juke -> juke-f15/juke-f16). The OSRAM CSV importer (react-app-tablet/scripts/ parse_osram_csv_to_json.cjs -> merge_light_positions.cjs -> add_slugs_to_bulbs.cjs) strips chassis/generation codes and only ever produces the single generic slug, so it cannot safely route rows to the correct sibling slug for these families. import_osram_lights_additive.cjs skips all of them entirely (additive-only, never touches this set) pending a real reconciliation -- no single heuristic covers all of them, confirmed empirically 2026-07-18.
